verses.text: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
Qenan, Mahalalyl, Yared,
Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.
Noah’ tapate Shem, Ham leh Yapheth ahi hi.
Yapheth suanlekhakte pen: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yavan, Tubal, Meshech, leh Tiras ahi hi.
Gomer’ suanlekhakte pen: Ashkenaz, Riphath leh Togarmah ahi hi.
Yavan’ suanlekhakte pen: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, leh Dodanim ahi hi.
Ham’ tapate pen: Cush, Mitzraim; Egypt, Put leh Canaan ahi hi.
Cush’ suanlekhakte pen: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah leh Sabtechah ahi hi. Raamah’ suanlekhakte pen Sheba leh Dedan ahi hi.
Cush pen nakpi taka Yahweh a langpang dingin a khangkhia Nimrod’ pupi ahi hi.
Mitzraim pen Lud mite, Anam mite, Lehab mite, Naphtuh mite,
Pathrus mite, Casluh mite leh Caphtor mite pianna pupi ahi hi (tuate panin Philistia mite piang hi).
Canaan pen a tacil Sidon leh Heth; Hit-te,
Yebus mite, Amor mite leh Girgash mite,
Hiv mite, Ark mite, Sin mite,
Arvad mite, Zemar mite leh Hamath mite’ pa ahi hi.
Shem’ tapate pen: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether leh Meshech ahi hi.
Arphaxad in ta Shelah nei a, Shelah in ta Eber a nei hi.
Eber sung panin tapa nih suak hi: khat’ min pen Peleng ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ama hun sungin leitung gam ciaptehnate kikhen hi; tua ciangin a sanggampa’ min pen Yoktan ahi hi.
Yoktan in Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Yerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah, leh Yobab nei hi—hihte khempeuh pen Yoktan’ tapate ahi hi.
Hih in Shem sung pana piangte ahi hi: Arphaxad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
leh Abram ahi hi; amah pen Abraham ahi hi.
Abraham’ tapate pen Isaac leh Ishmayl ahi hi.
Nebayoth pen Ishmayl’ tacil hi a, tua khit ciangin Ishmayl sung panin Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
Yetur, Naphish, leh Kedemah-te a suak hi. Hihte pen Ishmayl’ tapate ahi hi.
Abraham’ zineu Keturah sung pana suak tapate in: Zimran, Yokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, leh Shuah ahi hi. Yokshan’ suanlekhakte pen Sheba leh Dedan ahi hi.
Midian’ suanlekhakte pen Ephah, Epher, Henoch, Abida leh Eidaah ahi hi. Hihte khempeuh pen Keturah’ suante ahi hi.
Abraham in Sarah tawh Isaac nei hi. Rebekah kiang pana Isaac’ tapate in Esau leh Israyl ahi hi.
Esau’ tapate pen Eliphaz, Reuel, Yeush, Yalam leh Korah ahi hi.
Eliphaz’ suanlekhakte pen: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam leh Kenaz hi a, tua ciangin Timna tawh Amalek a nei hi.
Reuel’ suanlekhakte pen: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah leh Mizzah ahi hi.
Seir’ suanlekhakte pen: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer leh Dishan ahi hi.
Lotan’ suanlekhakte pen Hori leh Homam ahi hi. Timna pen Lotan’ sanggamnu ahi hi.
Shobal’ suanlekhakte pen: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi leh Onam ahi hi. Zibeon’ suanlekhakte pen Aiah leh Anah ahi hi.
Anah’ suanlekhak pen Dishon ahi hi. Dishon’ suanlekhakte pen: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran leh Cheran ahi hi.
Ezer’ tapate pen Bilhan, Zaavan leh Yakan ahi hi. Dishan’ suanlekhakte pen Uz leh Aran ahi hi.
Hihte khempeuh pen Israyl kumpi khat beek in a uk ma-in Edom gam sung a uk kumpite ahi hi: Beor’ tapa Bela hi a, a khuapi min pen Dinhabah ahi hi.
Bela a sih ciangin, Bozrah-a Zerah’ tapa Yobab in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yobab a sih ciangin, Teman mite gama Husham in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Husham a sih ciangin Moab gam ah Midian a zo Bedad’ tapa Hadad in kumpi’ za a luah hi. Ama khuapi min pen Avith ahi hi.
Hadad a sih ciangin Masrekah pana Samlah in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Samlah a sih ciangin Gun nai-a om Rehoboth pana Shaul in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Shaul a sih ciangin Achbor’ tapa Baal-Hanan in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Baal-Hanan a sih ciangin Hadad in a kumpi’ za a luah hi. Ama khuapi min pen Pai hi a, a zi’ min pen Mehetabel hi a, Me-Zahab’ tanu Matred’ tanu ahi hi.
Kumpi Hadad si hi. Tua ciangin Edom ukpite in uk a, tuate in: Ukpi Timnah, Ukpi Aliah, Ukpi Yetheth,
Ukpi Aholibamah, Ukpi Elah, Ukpi Pinon,
Ukpi Kenaz, Ukpi Teman, Ukpi Mibzar,
Ukpi Magdiel, leh Ukpi Iram ahi hi—hihte pen Edom ukpite ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Israyl’ tapate ahi hi: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Yahdah, Issachar, Zebulun,
Dan, Yahseph, Benyamin, Naphtali, Gad leh Asher ahi hi.
Yahdah’ tapate pen: Er, Onan leh Shelah—Canaan mi Shua’ tanu tawh a neih thumte ahi hi. Yahdah’ tacil Er pen Yahweh mit ah a sia-in gamta a, Amah in amah a that hi.
Tua ciangin a tapa’ zi Tamar tawh amah in ta nei a, Perez leh Zerah ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahdah’ tapate a vekpi-in nga ahi hi.
Perez’ tapate pen Hezron leh Hamul ahi hi.
Zerah’ tapate pen Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol leh Dara hi a—amaute a vekpi-in nga pha hi.
Carmi’ suanlekhak pen Achar (Achan) hi a, suksiat kiuhkeuh; cherem, dingin a kisehsa nate khatpeuh lak dingin a kikhamte ah a khial Israyl-te a buaisakpa ahi hi.
Ethan’ tapa pen Azatyah ahi hi.
Hezron sung pana piang tapate pen Yerahmeel, Ram leh Chelubai ahi hi.
Ram in ta Amminadab nei a, Amminadab pen Yahdah mite makai khat ahi Nahshon’ pa ahi hi.
Nahshon in ta Salmon nei a, Salmon in ta Boaz nei hi.
Boaz in ta Obed nei a, Obed in ta Yishai nei hi.
Yishai tapate: a tacil Eliab, a nihna Abinadab leh a thumna Shammah,
a lina Nethanel, a ngana Raddai,
a gukna Ozem, leh a sagihna David ahi hi.
A sanggam numeite uh pen: Zeruyah leh Abigail ahi hi. Zeruyah’ tapate pen Abishai, Yahab leh Asahel ahi hi—amau teng thum pen David’ galkap mangte ahi hi.
Abigail in tapa Amasa nei a, galkap mangin a kiseh hi a, ahih hangin Yahab in amah that hi. Amasa’ pa pen Ishmayl mi Yether ahi hi.
Hezron’ tapa Caleb in a zi Azubah leh Yerioth tawh ta nei hi. Hihte pen tuanu tapate ahi hi:Yesher, Shobab leh Ardon ahi hi.
Azubah a sih ciangin Caleb in Ephrathah tenpihin tuanu in amah tawh tapa Hur a nei hi.
Hur in ta Uri nei a, Uri in ta Bezaleel nei hi.
Tua nung ciangin Hezron in Gilead’ pa Machir’ tanu a tenpih a, amah kum 60 a phak ciangin tuanu in amah tawh Segub a nei hi.
Segub pen Gilead gam sungah khuapi sawmnih le thum a nei Yair’ pa ahi hi.
(Ahih hangin Geshur leh Aram in Havvoth Yair khuapi, Kenath leh a kiimkota khuaneute—khuaneu 60 matsak hi.) Hihte khempeuh pen Gilead’ pa Machir’ suanlekhakte ahi hi.
Caleb Ephrathah ah Hezron a sih khit ciangin Hezron’ zi Abiyah in ama’ tapa Ashur nei a, amah pen Tekoa’ pa ahi hi.
Hezron’ tacil Yerahmeel’ suanlekhakte pen: a tacil Ram, tua khit ciangin Bunah, Oren, Ozem leh Ahiyah ahi hi.
Yerahmeel in zi dang khat nei a, a min Atarah ahi hi. Tuanu pen Onam’ nu ahi hi.
Yerahmeel’ tacil Ram’ tapate pen Maaz, Yamin leh Eker ahi hi.
Onam’ tapate pen Shammai leh Yada ahi hi. Shammai’ tapate pen Nadab leh Abishur ahi hi.
Amah tawh Ahban leh Molid a neihpih Abishur’ zi min pen Abihail ahi hi.
Nadab’ tapate pen Seled leh Appayim hi a, ahih hangin Seled ta nei loin a si hi.
Appayim’ tapa pen Ishi ahi hi. Ishi’ tapa pen Sheshan hi a, Sheshan’ tapa pen Ahlai ahi hi.
Shammai sanggampa Yada’ tapate pen Yether leh Yahnathan hi a, ahih hangin Yether tapa nei loin a si hi.
Yahnathan’ tapate pen Peleth leh Zaza ahi hi—hihte pen Yerahmeel’ suanlekhakte ahi hi.
Tu-in Sheshan in tapa nei loin amah in tanu bek a nei hi. Sheshan in Egypt mi nasem khat nei a, a min Yarha ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Sheshan in kitenna tawh a nasempa Yarha tungah a tanu pia a, tuanu in amah tawh Attai a nei hi.
Attai in ta Nathan nei a, Nathan in ta Zabad nei hi;
Zabad in ta Ephlal nei a, Ephlal in ta Obed nei hi;
Obed in ta Yahu nei a, Yahu in ta Azaryah nei hi;
Azaryah in ta Helez nei a, Helez in ta Eleasah nei hi;
Eleasah in ta Sismai nei a, Sismai in ta Shallum nei hi;
Shallum in ta Yekamyah nei a, Yekamyah in ta Elishama nei hi.
Yerahmeel’ sanggampa Caleb’ suanlekhakte pen: a tacil Mesha hi a, amah pen Ziph’ pa ahi hi; a tapa Mareshah pen Hebron’ pa ahi hi.
Hebron’ tapate pen: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, leh Shema ahi hi.
Shema ta Raham pen Yorkoam’ pa hi a, Rekem in ta Shammai nei hi;
Shammai in ta Maon nei a, Maon in ta Beth Zur nei hi;
Caleb’ zineu Ephah pen Haran, Moza, leh Gazez-te’ nu ahi hi. Haran in ta Gazez a nei hi.
Yachdai’ tapate pen: Regem, Yahtham, Gesham, Pelet, Ephah leh Shaaph ahi hi.
Caleb’ zineu Maachah in ta Sheber leh Tirhanah a nei hi.
Tuanu in Madmannah’ pa Shaaph, leh Machbeam leh Gibea-te’ pa Sheva zong a nei hi. Caleb’ tanu pen Achsah ahi hi.
Hihte pen Caleb’ tapate hi a, Ephrahthah tacil Hur’ tapate pen: Kiryath Yearim’ pa Shobal,
Bethlehem’ pa Salma (Salmon), leh Beth Gader’ pa Hareph ahi uh hi.
Kiryath Yearim’ pa Shobal’ suanlekhakte pen: Haroeth, Manaheth mi alang leh,
Kiryath Yearim behte: Ithri mite, Puth mite, Shumath mite leh Mishrai mite ahi hi. Hihte panin Zorath mite leh Eshtaol mite a piang hi.
Salmon’ suanlekhakte pen: Bethlehem, Netophath mite, Ataroth Beth Yahab, Manaheth mi alang leh Zor mite ahi hi.
Yabez-a teng beh lai-atte; soferim, pen: Tirath mite, Shimeath mite leh Suchath mite ahi uh hi. Hihte pen Rechab’ innkuante’ pa Hemath’ suan Ken mite ahi uh hi.

headings.text: Salin a Kikaih Zawha Kumpi Guite

verses.text: Hihte pen Hebron-a a suak David’ tapate minte ahi hi: Yezreel mi Ahimoam tawh a neih a tacil Amnon ahi hi. A ta nihna pen Carmel mi Abigail tawh a neih Daniyl (Chileab) ahi hi.
A ta thumna pen Geshur kumpipa Talmai’ tanu Maachah tawh a neih Absalom ahi hi. A ta lina pen Haggith tawh a neih Adoniyah ahi hi.
A ta ngana pen Abital tawh a neih Shephatyah ahi hi. A ta gukna pen a zi Eglah tawh a neih Ithream ahi hi.
Hebron ah ama tung pana piang tapa guk ahi hi. Amah in tua lai-ah kum sagih leh kha guk uk a, Yerusalem ah amah in kum sawmthum le kum thum uk hi.
Hih tapate pen Yerusalem ah ama tung pana piang ahi hi: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, leh Solomon—a li-in Ammiel’ (Eliam) tanu Bathshua (Bathsheba) tawh a neih ahi hi.
Tua banah Ibhar, Ylishama (Ylishua), Yliphelet,
Nogah, Nepheg, Yaphia,
Ylishama, Ylyada, leh Yliphelet—amaute kua pha uh hi.
Hihte pen a zineute’ tapate leh a sanggamnu Tamar banah David’ tapate khempeuh ahi hi.
Solomon’ tapa pen Rehoboam; Rechabam, ahi hi. A tapa Abiyah, a tapa Asa, a tapa Yahshaphat,
a tapa Yahram, a tapa Abazyah, a tapa Yahash,
a tapa Amazyah, a tapa Azaryah, a tapa Yahtham,
a tapa Ahaz, a tapa Hezekyah, a tapa Menasheh,
a tapa Amon leh a tapa Yoshiyah ahi uh hi.
Yoshiyah’ tapate pen: a tacil Yahchanan (Yahahaz), a nihna Yahyakim, a thumna Zedekyah leh a lina Shallum ahi hi.
Yahyakim’ za luahte pen: a tapa Yekonyah (Yahyakin) leh Yahyakim’ sanggampa Zedekyah ahi hi.
Yekonyah (Yahyakin) salin a kimat sunga a tapate pen: Assir, a tapa Shealtiel,
Malchiram, Pedayah, Shenazar, Yekamyah, Hoshama, leh Nedabyah ahi hi.
Pedayah’ tapate pen Zerubbabel leh Shimei ahi hi. Zerubbabel’ tapate pen Meshullam leh Hananyah ahi hi. Shelomith pen a sanggamnu uh ahi hi.
Tua banah Hashubah, Ohel, Berechyah, Hasadyah leh Yushab-Chesed—a vekpi-in nga ahi hi.
Hananyah’ tapate pen Pelatyah leh Yeshayah, leh Rephayah’ tapate, Arnan’ tapate, Obadyah’ tapate leh Shechanyah’ tapate ahi hi.
Shechanyah’ tapa pen Shemayah ahi hi. Shemayah’ tapate pen: Hattush, Igeal, Bariach, Nearyah leh Shaphat hi a—a vekpi-in guk ahi hi.
Nearyah’ tapate pen: Al-Yahenai, Hezekyah, leh Azrikam hi a—a vekpi-in thum ahi hi.
Al-Yahnenai’ tapate pen: Hodayah, Eliashib, Pelayah, Akkub, Yahchanan, Delayah leh Anani hi a—a vekpi-in sagih ahi hi.
Yahdah’ tapate pen: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, leh Shobal ahi hi.
Shobal in ta Reayah nei a, Reayah’ ta Yachath, Yachath’ ta Ahumai leh Lahad ahi hi. Hihte pen Zorath mite behte ahi hi.
Hihte pen Etam’ pa Hareph’ tapate ahi hi: Yezreel, Ishma, leh Idbash ahi hi. A sanggamnu uh pen Ha-Tzelelponi ahi hi.
Penuel pen Gedo’ pa hi a, Ezer pen Hushah’ pa ahi hi. Hihte pen Ephrath’ tapa masa, Bethlehem’ pa Hur’ suanlekhakte ahi hi.
Tekoa’ pa Ashhur in zi nih nei a—Helah leh Naarah ahi hi.
Naarah in amah tawh ta Ahuzam, Hepher, Temeni, leh Haahashtari a nei hi. Hihte pen Naarah’ tapate ahi hi.
Helah’ tapate pen: Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
leh Koz hi a (amah pen Anub, Ha-Tzobebah leh Rarum’ tapa Aharhel’ behte’ pa ahi hi).
Yabez pen a sanggamte sangin pahtawi huaizaw a, ahih hangin a nu in a min Yabez; Amah in Nasak ding hi, ci-in phuak hi; “bang hang hiam cihleh nasapi-in amah ka hingkhia hi,” a ci hi.

Israyl’ Pa tungah Yabez kiko-in, “Aw, Nangmah in kei thupha hong pia taktakin ka gam hong khatsak inla, Na khutte in kei hong ompihin kei hong kinatsak loh nadingin siatna panin kei hong kem in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in ama ngetna a pia hi.
Shuhah’ sanggampa Chelub in ta Mehir nei a, amah pen Eshton’ pa ahi hi.
Eshton in ta Beth-Rapha, Paseah, leh Ir-Nahash’ pa Tehinnah a nei hi. Hihte pen Rechah mite ahi uh hi.
Kenaz’ tapate pen: Othniel leh Serayah ahi hi. Othniel’ tapate pen: Hathath leh,
Meonothai hi a (amah in ta Ophrah a nei hi). Serayah’ tapa pen Yahab hi a, Ge-Char-ashim’ pa; Khutsiamte Kuam, ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute khutsiamte ahih manin tua bangin kiphuak ahi hi.
Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb’ tapate pen: Iru, Elah leh Naam ahi hi. Elah’ tapa pen Kenaz ahi hi.
Yehallelel’ tapate pen: Ziph, Ziphaha, Titia leh Asareel ahi hi.
Ezrahyah’ tapate pen Yether, Mered, Epher leh Yalon ahi hi. Mered’ zi in ta Miriam, Shammai leh Eshtemoa’ pa Ishbah a nei hi.
(Yahdah mi ama zi in tapa: Gedor’ pa Yered, Socoh’ pa Heber leh Zanoah’ pa Yekuthiel a nei hi.) Hihte pen Mered in a tenpih Pharaoh’ tanu Bithyah’ tate ahi hi.
Naham’ sanggamnu, Hodiyah’ zi tapate pen: Garm mi Keilah’ pa leh Maachath mi Eshtemoa’ pa ahi hi.
Shimon’ tapate pen: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan leh Tilon ahi hi. Ishi’ tapate pen Zoheth leh Ben-Zoheth ahi hi.
Yahdah’ tapa ahi Shelah’ tapate pen: Lecah’ pa Er, Mareshah’ pa Laadah leh Beth Ashbea-a saihadial puan gan mite’ beh teng leh,
Yahkim, Chozeba mite, Yahash leh Moab-te tenpihin Bethlehem-a a ciahkik Saraph ahi hi. (Hih ciaptehnate tanglai peka ahi hi.)
Amaute pen Netaim leh Gederah-a teng beelseekte hi uh a, kumpipa nasepna tua lai-ah a om uh hi.
Simeon’ suanlekhakte pen: Nemuel, Yamin, Yarib (Yakin), Zerah leh Shaul ahi hi.
Shallum pen Shaul’ tapa ahi hi. Shallum in ta Mibsam nei a, Mibsam in ta Mishma nei hi.
Hamuel pen Mishma’ tapa ahi hi. Hamuel in ta Zacchur nei a, Zacchur in ta Shimei a nei hi.
Shimei in tapa sawm le guk leh tanu guk nei hi; ahih hangin a sanggam pasalte in ta tampi nei lo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahdah mite zahin amau beh buppi tampi a pha kei uh hi.
Amaute pen Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar Shaul,
Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, Beth Birei, leh Shaaraim khuate ah teng uh hi. Hihte pen David’ uk hun dong amaute khuapite ahi hi.
A kiimkota khuaneute pen: Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen leh Ashan hi a, khuaneu nga—
leh Baalath Beer ciang dong khuapite kiimkota om khuaneute khempeuh tawh ahi hi. Hih pen amaute tenna mun hi a, amaute in khang ciaptehna a nei uh hi.
Meshobab, Yamlech leh Aazyah’ tapa Yoshayah;
Yahyl leh Asiel’ tapa Serayah’ tapa Yoshibyah’ tapa Yahu;
Al-Yahenai, Yaakobah, Yeshochayah, Asayah, Adiel, Yesimiel leh Benayah;
Shemayah’ tapa Shimri’ tapa Yedayah’ tapa Allon’ tapa Shiphi’ tapa Ziza ahi hi.
Hih a minin a kigual mite pen a beh zui-a makaite hi a, amau beh ciat nakpi takin khang hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a tuuhonte aa dingin lonona zongin kuam ni suahna lampang Gedor lutna ciang dong a pai uh hi.
Amaute in lei hoih, lonona, leh gam zai-in gam dai-in a nopna mun a mu uh hi. Ham’ suanlekhakte ni dangin tua lai-ah teng ngei uh hi.

Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah uk hun sungin a minin kigual hih mite pai-in, a puanbukte leh tua lai-a a tennate ah Ham mite simin tuni donga mah bangin amaute a susia kiuhkeuh uh hi. Ham-te tenna mun ah amaute teng uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua lai-ah a tuuhonte aa dingin lonona a om hi.
Hih Simeon mi 500 in Seir mualtung gam a sim uh hi. Ishi’ tapate Pelatyah, Nearyah, Rephanyah leh Uzziel-te in amaute a makaih uh hi.
Amaute in Amalek mi a suakta a omlai sunte susia-in, tuni dongin tua lai-ah a teng uh hi.

Israyl’ tacil Reuben’ tapate pen: (Amah pen tacil hi a, ahih hangin amah in a pa’ lupna ninsak ahih manin tacil hihna hamphatna pen Israyl’ tapa Yahseph suante tungah kipia hi; tua ahih manin tapa upapen hihna tawh kizui-in khangthu ciaptehna ah amah kigual lo hi.
Yahdah pen a sanggam pasalte lakah thahatpen hi a, ama sung panin ukpa khat a pian hangin tacil hamphatna pen Yahseph aa ahi hi)—
Israyl’ tacil Reuben’ tapate pen: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron leh Carmi ahi hi.
Yahyl’ tapate: Shemayah, Shemayah in ta Gog nei a, Gog in ta Shimei nei hi;
Shimei in ta Micahyah nei a, Micahyah in ta Reayah nei a, Reayah in ta Baal nei hi;
Assyria kumpipa Tilgath Pilneser in salin a kaih Beerah pen Baal’ tapa ahi hi. Beerah pen Reuben mite makai khat ahi hi.
Amau khanggui ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a sanggamte uh leh a kinaipihte a behbeh-a kigual ahi hi: Ukpi Yeiel, Zecharyah,
Aroer panin Nebo leh Baal Meon ciang donga teng Yahyl tapa Shema, a tapa Azaz, a tapa Bela ahi uh hi.
Euphrates Gun dong a ban sehnel gam ciang dong, ni suahna lamah amaute teng uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Gilead gam sungah a gan khawite uh tampi a pha hi.
Shaul uk hun sungin amaute in Hagari-te simin amaute khut tawh a zo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Gilead ni suahna lam huam buppi ah a puanbukte tawh a teng uh hi.
Amaute zom, Salcah ciang dong Bashan gam sungah Gad’ mite teng uh hi:
Ukpi Yahyl hi a, a zom ah Shapham ahi hi; tua khit ciangin Bashan gam sungah Yaanai leh Shaphat ahi hi.
A sanggamte leh a kinaipihte a innkuankuanin: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Yorai, Yachan, Zia leh Heber hi a—a vekpi-in sagih ahi hi.
Hihte pen Buz’ tapa Yachdo’ tapa Yeshishai’ tapa Michael’ tapa Gilead’ tapa Yaroach’ tapa Hurl’ tapa ahi Abihail’ tapate ahi hi.
Guni’ tapa Abdiel, a tapa Ahi pen amau beh sungah ukpi ahi hi.
Bashan gam Gilead leh a khuaneute leh amau gam sung Sharon-a gam-awng khempeuh ah Gad mite a teng uh hi.
Hihte khempeuh pen Yahdah kumpi Yahtham uk hun sung leh Israyl kumpi Yeroboam uk hun sunga khangthu a kiciamtehte ahi hi.
Reuben mi, Gad mi leh Menasheh minam alangte in galsimzia a kihilhsa mi thahat, lum leh namsau a tawi thei, thal a kap thei mi 44,760 a nei uh hi.
Amaute in Hagari mite, Yetur, Naphish leh Nodab a sim uh hi.

A kido hun sungin Yahweh kiangah amaute kiko uh ahih manin kidona ah amaute a kihuh hi. Amah in Hagari-te leh amaute tawh a om khempeuh amau khut sungah a pia hi. Amaute in amau muanna Ama sungah koih uh ahih manin Amah in amaute’ thungetna a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a galte’ ganhon neihsa khempeuh—kalaoh 50,000, tuu 250,000 leh laa 2,000 la a, mi 100,000 zong a man uh hi;

Amah in amaute kiangah, “Note pen Levi innkuan lutangte na hi uh hi. Ka bawlkholhsa mun ah Israyl’ Pa Yahweh’ singkuang na puaktoh theih nadingin no na hi a, na sanggamte khempeuh ahi zongin kisiansuah unla ki-ap un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a masa hun no Levi mite in na puaktoh lohna uh hang leh a ngeina banga puak dingzia Ama i dot lohna hangin Yahweh i Pa in eite tungah hong gimsak hi.

David Khuapi ah Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang a lut laitakin Shaul’ tanu Michal in tawllet khat panin a na en hi. Tuanu in lamin a gualnuama om Kumpi David mu a, tua ciangin amah in a lungsim sungah a neu-et hi.

David in meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate a piak khit ciangin, amah in Yahweh’ Min tawh mipite thupha a pia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh Israyl khempeuh tungah anlum khat, nisuh moh khat leh leenggah moh khat ciat a pia hi.
Amah in Yahweh mai-ah biaknasep a sem ding, Israyl’ Pa Yahweh a phawksak ding, lungdam a ko ding leh a phat dingin Levi-te pawlkhat a seh hi. Amaute kiseh hi:

Asaf a ukpi hi a, tua khit ciangin ama nuai-a-te pen: Zecharyah, Yeiel, Shemiramoth, Yehiel, Mattithyah, Eliab, Benayah leh Obed-Edom hi a—Asaph in daltuah a ginsak ciangin amaute in harp khausaite leh zither khausai a tumte ahi uh hi.
Siampite: Benayah leh Yachaziel in Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang mai-ah a hunhunin peengkulte; chatsoseroth, muut uh hi.
Tua ni, Yahweh tungah lungdam lasaknate a kipat hunin David in Asaph leh a sanggamte tungah hih lungdamkohna la a pia hi:
“Yahweh tungah lungdam unla Ama Min lo un! Minamte tungah Ama sepnate theisak un.
Ama tungah la sa unla, Ama tungah phatna la sa un! Ama sep na lamdang khempeuh genin nei un!
Ama Min Siangtho hangin nuamin diang unla, Yahweh a zong mi khempeuh lungdam-kipaak uh hen!
Yahweh leh ama hatna kan unla, Ama maipha zong tawntung un!
Ama hong piaksa lim leh thukhennate, ama sepsa na lamdangte phawk un,
no Ama nasem Israyl’ khaici, Yaaqob’ tate, ama teelsa-te aw!
Amah pen Yahweh i Pa ahi hi! Leitung khempeuh ah ama thukhennate om hi.
Amah in a thuciamna phawk tawntung hi; khang tul khat aa dingin thu a piak Thukham—
tua in Abraham tawh a bawl, Isaac tungah a ciam kiciamna,
Yaaqob tungah ngeina kip khatin, Israyl tungah tawntung thuciamna-in kipsak a,
‘Nangma tungah na luah dingin sehtanh-in Canaan gam kong pia ding hi,’ ci hi.
Note tawmkhat bek na phak uh ciangin tawm takpi-in, tua gam ah khualmi na hi uh hi.
Gam khat panin gam khat ah, kumpigam khat panin adang mite kiangah amaute a pai kawikawi uh ciangin,
Amah in amaute a nengniam ding mi kuamah phal lo hi. Hi hi, Yahweh in amaute hangin kumpite tai a,
‘Ka sathau nilhsate khoih kei un! Ka kamsangte na sak kei un!’ a ci hi.
Leitung khempeuh aw, Yahweh tungah la sa un! Ni khat khit ni khat ama hong hotkhiatna tangko un!
Minamte lakah ama minthanna genkhia unla, minam khempeuh laka ama nasepnate genkhia un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh lian mahmah a, nakpi takin phat ding ahi hi! Amah pen pasiante (elohim) khempeuh khengin zahtak ding ahi hi.
Minamte pasiante (elohim) khempeuh pen bangmah-a kimanglo nate hi a, a mawknapi ahi hi! Ahih hangin Yahweh in vantungte bawl hi.
Ama omna ah minthanna leh pahtawina om a, Ama mun ah thahatna leh lungnopna om hi.
Minam innkuante aw, Yahweh tungah pia unla, minthanna leh thahatna Ama tungah pia un!
Ama Min in a ngah ding kilawm minthanna Yahweh tungah pia un! Biakna paipih-in Ama mai-ah pai un! Ama puan siangthote tawh Yahweh bia un!
Leitung khempeuh aw, Ama mai-ah liing un! Leitung kiptakin kikhosak a, a kikhin thei kei hi.
Vantungte nuam uh henla, leitung kipaak tahen! Minamte lakah amaute in, ‘Yahweh pen Kumpi hi,’ ci ta uh hen!
Tuipi leh a sunga om khempeuh hawk henla, gamlak leh a sunga om khempeuh nuam uh hen!
Leitung thu a khen dingin Amah hong pai ding ahih manin gammang tulaka singkungte Yahweh mai-ah nuam mahmah ding uh hi!
Yahweh tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah migi-in ama itna kip tawntung hi!

Kiko unla, ‘Kote Honpa Yahweh aw, kote hong hon in; Nangma Min Siangtho tungah lungdam kong koh theih nading uhleh Nangmah phatna ah ka minthan theih nadingun kote hong kaikhawm inla, Gentile mite kiang panin kote hong hon in!
Tawntung panin tawntung dong ah Israyl’ Pa Yahweh kiphat tahen!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin mite khempeuh in, “Tua bang hi tahen! HalleluYahweh!” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in nisima a kisam bangin singkuang mai-ah tatsat lo-a na a sem dingin Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang mai tua lai-ah Asaph leh a sanggamte a nusia hi.
Amah in amau tawh na a sem dingin Obed-Edom leh a sanggamte sawmguk le giat a nusia hi. Yeduthun’ tapa Obed-Edom leh Hosah zong kongcingte ahi uh hi.

-40 Ahih hangin Yahweh in Israyl-te thu a piak Yahweh’ Thukham sunga kigelh khempeuh tawh kizui-in a sem ding leh zingsang leh nitak, meihal biaknatau tungah a hunhuna kipia meihal biaknate, Yahweh tungah a pia dingin Gibeon munsanga Yahweh’ biakbuk mai-ah siampi Zadok leh a sanggam siampite a nusia hi.
Amaute tawh Heman, Yeduthun leh, Ama itna kip tawntung ahih manin Yahweh tungah lungdam a ko dingin a kiteel, a minin a kilokhia a cianlaite tawh a om uh hi.
Heman leh Yeduthun in peengkulte; chatsoserot, leh daltuahte a gingsak ding, Yahweh’ late aa dingin tumging dangte a tum dingin vaipuak nei uh hi. Yeduthun’ tapate pen kongcingte ahi uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin mi khempeuh a inn ciat ah ciah uh hi. Tua ciangin David zong a innkuan thupha pia dingin a ciahkik hi.
David ama kumpi-inn ah a ten khit ciangin, David in kamsang Nathan kiangah, “Taamtak inn sung hih lai-ah kei ka teng a, ahih hangin Yahweh’ singkuang pen puanbuk sunglam ah omlai hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Nathan in David kiangah, “Pai inla, na lungsima om bangbangin sem in; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in nang hong ompih hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua zanin Nathan tungah Yahweh’ kammal hong tung a,
“Pai inla ka nasempa David kiangah gen in: ‘Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: A sungah ka ten nading Inn khat na lam kei ding hi.
Israyl-te ka paipihtoh huna kipanin tuni mahmah dong inn khatpeuh sungah ka teng ngei kei hi. Biakbuk khat sunga puanbuk khat panin puanbuk khat ah ka pai hi.

Israyl khempeuh tawh ka kikhinna peuhpeuh ah ka mite a cing dingin thu ka piak amaute tungah, ‘Bang hangin taamtak sing tawh inn hong lamsak lo na hi uh hiam?’ ci-in Israyl thukhente khatpeuh tungah kammal khat beek ci ngei ka hi hiam?
Tu-in ka nasempa David tunga hih bangin gen in: Vanglianpen Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Ka mi Israyl-te tungah ukpa ahi dingin lonona pan leh tuuhon zuihna panin nang kong la hi.
Na paina peuhpeuh ah nang kong ompih a, nangma mai panin na galte khempeuh susia-in leitunga mi lianpente bangin min kong ngahsak hi.

-10 Ka mite Israyl-te aa dingin mun khat ka pia ding a, amaute ka suan ding hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in amau inn ding nei-in a tai nawn kei ding uh hi. Keimah in ka mi Israyl-te tungah a thumaan thukhente thu ka piak huna kipan, a kipat cila amau hih bangin gitlohna’ tapate in amaute nengniam nawn lo ding uh a, tua ciangin keimah in na galte khempeuh zong kong zosak ding hi. Tua bek tham loin nang tungah kong gen inah: Yahweh in nang aa ding inn khat hong lamsak ding hi.
Na nuntakna a bei ciang, na pate lampi ah na pai ciangin na tapate khat, nang khita na khaici ka kipsak ding a, keimah in ama kumpigam ka kipsak ding hi.
Amah in Kei aa dingin Inn khat hong lamsakin, tua ciangin keimah in ama kumpi-tokhom a tawntungin ka kipsak ding hi.
Kei pen ama Pa ka hi ding a, amah pen Ka tapa ahi ding hi. Na mai-a pa kiang panin ka itna ka lakkhiat bangin ama kiang panin ka itna ka lakhia kei ding hi.
Keimah in Ka Inn leh Ka kumpigam ah a tawntungin amah ka koih ding hi. Tua ciangin ama kumpi-tokhom kip tawntung ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Hih thute khempeuh leh hih mangmuhna khempeuh Nathan in David tungah a gen hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi David lutin Yahweh mai-ah tu a, amah in, “Pa Yahweh aw, hih ciang dong kei nong tunpih liang nadingin kei kua hi a, ka innkuanpihte bang hilel ahi hiam?

Tua hi a, Pa Yahweh aw, nang muhna ah hihte a kicing lo bang ahih hangin na nasempa innkuan vai mailam aa ding zong nong gen khin zo a, nakpi taka a kilamsang mipa’ za neihna bangin kei nong lamsang hi, Yahweh ka Pa aw!
Na nasempa pahtawi nadingin Nang tungah David in bang hong gen beh nawn ding ka hi hiam?
Yahweh aw, Na nasempa na cihna leh Nangma deihna tawh kizui-in hih na lianpite na semkhin a, hih thuciamna lianpite na kitheikhiasak hi.
Yahweh aw, Nang tawh a kibang khat beek om lo a, ka bil-a ka zak uh mah bangin Nang tawh a kibang pasian (el) khat beek a om kei hi.

Ama mi-in a tankhia dingin a Pa uh a kuankhia leitunga minam khat ahi Na mi Israyl-te tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam? Egypt panin na tatkhiat na mite mai panin minamte na hawlkhiat ciangin a lian a lamdang pipite sepna tawh nang aa dingin Min khat na bawl hi.
Na mi Israyl-te a tawntungin nang aituam dingin na bawl a, tua ciangin Yahweh aw, nang pen amaute Pa na suak hi.
Tu-in Yahweh aw, na nasempa leh ama innkuan tawh kisai-in na ciamsa kammal a tawntungin kip henla, nong ciamsa bangin hong sem ta in.

Nangma Min a kiliat tawntungsak theih nadingin hih thu kikipsak tahen! Tua ciangin mite in, “Vanglianpen Yahweh, Israyl-te tunga Pa pen Israyl-te’ Pa ahi hi!” ci ding uh hi. Nangma mai-ah na nasempa David innkuan kikipsak hen;

bang hang hiam cihleh ka Pa aw, ama aa dingin inn khat na lamsak ding thu nangmah in na nasempa kiangah na laak khin hi. Hihte khempeuh hangin na nasempa in nangma tungah hih thungetna nget dingin a lungsim sungah hong suak hi.
Tu-in Yahweh aw, Nang pen ka Pa na hi a, Nangmah in na nasempa tungah hih a thumaan kamciamna nong pia khin hi.

Nangma mai-ah a tawntungin a kizop paisuak theih nadingin na nasempa innkuan thupha piak ding hong lungkim in. Pa Yahweh aw, nangmah in thupha piakhin a, Na nasempa innkuan a tawntungin thupha kipia tahen,” a ci hi.
Hih in tua thu khit cianga piang hi a, David in Philistia-te do-in amaute zo a, Philistia-te khut sung panin Gath leh a kiima tennate a la hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in Moab-te zo hi. Moab mite pen David’ khutnuai mi suak a, ama kiangah siah a puak uh hi.

Yahab in a mai leh a nung ah galte a om lai a theih ciangin amah in Israyl mi gal siampen pawlkhat teelin, Aram mite a sim dingin a sawl hi.

Amah in thupia a, “Aram mite kei aa dingin a hatluat uh leh, kei hong huh inla, Ammon mite nang aa dingin a hatluat leh nang kong huh ding hi.
Nakpi takin hangsan inla, i mite aa ding, i Pa khuapite aa dingin thahat ni! Yahweh in ama mit ah man a sak bangin hih tahen!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahab leh amah tawh a om mite in Aram mite sim dingin kuan uh a, tua ciangin Aram-te amau mai panin a taikek uh hi.
Aram mite a tai lam Ammon mite in a theih uh ciangin a sanggampa Abishai kiang panin amaute zong tai-in khuapi sungah a lut uh hi. Tua ciangin Yerusalem ah Yahab a ciahkik hi.

Israyl-te mai panin Aram mite taikek uh hi. David in sakol tung tuangte 7,000 leh khe gakap 40,000 that hi. Amah in a galkap mangpa Shophach zong a that hi.
Israyl mite in amaute a zawh lam Hadadezar’ uliante in a theih uh ciangin, amaute in David tawh kilemna bawlin ama khutnuai mi a suak uh hi. Aram mite in Ammon mite a huh nuam nawn kei uh hi.

Khuakhal hun sung kumpite gal a kuankhiat hunin Yahab in a galkapte kuankhiatpih a, Ammon mite gam susiagawpin, tua khit ciangin pai-in Rabbah a umcih uh hi; tua hunin Yerusalem ah David a omlai hi. Yahab in Rabbah zo-in a lumlet hi.

Tua ciangin David in a kumpipa; Milcom, Molech, uh lu tung panin kham talent khat a gik, suang manphate tawh a kizem lukhu khat la hi. Tua pen David’ lu tungah a kikhusak hi. Amah in khuapi panin van kinusia tampitak zong a puakhia hi.

Amah in tua lai-a om mite paikhiatpihin, sing-atte, tuzumte leh heite tawh na a sem dingin a koih hi. David in Ammon mite khuapite khempeuh ah hih bangin ahih hi. Tua khit ciangin Yerusalem ah David leh a mite khempeuh a ciahkik uh hi.
Hih hun khit ciangin Gazer ah Philistia-te tawh kidona a om hi. Tua hun lai-in Hushath mi Sibbechai in mi golpite’ suan khat ahi Sippai that a, tua ciangin Philistia-te a kinuaisiah hi.
Philistia-te tawh kidona om kik leuleu a, Yair’ tapa Elhanan in siam lawngpi tawh a kibang teipi a nei Git mi Goliath sanggampa Lahmi a that hi.

Gath ah kidona om leuleu a, tua lai-ah a khut langtuak ah khutme guk nei-in a khe langtuak ah kheme guk a nei, a khutme leh a kheme sawmnih le li a pha mi gol mahmah khat a om hi. Amah zong mi gol mahmah-te suan ahi hi.
Amah in Israyl phinin a ko ciangin, David’ sanggampa Shammah’ tapa Yahnathan in amah a that hi.
Hihte pen Gath gam sunga om mi golpite suante hi a, David’ khut leh a mite khut hangin amaute puk uh hi.

headings.text: David in Galsimthei Mi Phazah Sim

verses.text: Israyl langpanin Satan ding a, David in Israyl-te a mipha zah a sim nadingin a hanthawn hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Yahab leh a mipi makaite thupia-in, “Pai unla, Dan panin Beersheba dong Israyl-te sim un; A phazah ka theih nadingin kei kiangah hong genkik un,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Yahab in, “Yahweh in ama mite a phazah sangin a zah zakhatin tamzawsak tahen. Ahih hangin ka uk kumpipa aw, amaute khempeuh na nasemte ahi uh hi. Tua hi a, bang hangin hi bang na hih nuam na hi hiam? Bang hangin amah in Israyl tungah mawhna tun ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa’ kammal in Yahab’ thugenna hoih khupnelh gawp hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahab kuankhia-in Israyl sung khempeuh ah pai a, a tawpna ah Yerusalem hong ciahkik hi.
Yahab in David kiangah a vekpi-a gawmsa mi phazah a gen hi. Israyl mi khempeuh in Yahdah mi 470,000 zong a kihel namsau a tawi thei mi 1,100,000 nei uh a,
ahih hangin amah in mi simna sungah Levi leh Benyamin a sim kei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in kumpipa’ thupiakna a zadah hi.
Yahweh in hih thu hoihsa lo a, tua ahih manin amah in Israyl-te dan a pia hi.

Tua ciangin David in Yahweh kiangah, “Hih na ka hih manin nakpi takin a mawh hi. Ahi zongin tu-in kong thuum hi, a haivai mahmahin gamta kha ka hih manin na nasempa gamtatkhialhna hong maisak in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in David’ thumupa Gad kiangah a gen inah:
“Pai inla David kiangah gen in: Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Nangma tungah teel ding nam thum kong pia hi. Nang tungah kong tunsak dingin nang mahmah in tuate khat teel in,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David kiangah Gad pai a, ama kiangah, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Nang aa dingin teel in:

‘Kum thum sung kialpi tun ding, na galte in hong zo-in namsau tawh kha thum sung hong delh ding, ahih kei leh Yahweh’ namsau tawh ni thum sung—gam sunga pulpi tungin Israyl gam sung khempeuh Yahweh’ vantungmi in a suk ding, na deihzawk teel in,’ ci hi. Kei hong sawlpa kiangah a paipihkik ding dawnna tu-in khensat in,” a ci hi.

David in Gad kiangah, “Ka lungkham lua mahmah hi. Yahweh’ khut sungah hong puksak in; bang hang hiam cihleh ama hehpihnate nakpi-in lian hi; ahih hangin mihingte khut sungah hong puksak kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Israyl tungah pulpi tungsak a, tua ciangin Israyl-te mi 70,000 a si hi.

Yahweh in Yerusalem a susia dingin vantungmi khat sawl a, ahih hangin amah in a suksiat laitakin Yahweh in en a, nakpi-in a dantatna nemsakin, a hehpih hi. Amah in a susia vantungmi kiangah, “Pha zo! Na khut dokkik in!” a ci hi. Tua-in Yebus mi Ornan’ ancilna ah Yahweh’ vantungmi a om laitak ahi hi.

David a khuadak ciangin leitung leh vantung kikalah Yahweh’ vantungmi dingin a khut sunga namsau khat tawh Yerusalem tungah a khut a zankhia a mu hi. Tua ciangin David leh upate in ippi puan silhin, a maipuk uh hi.

David in Yahweh kiangah, “Galkapte a kisim nadingin thu a piapa kei hilo ka hi hiam? Mawhin hih khialhna a gamta kei hilo ka hi hiam? Ahih hangin hih tuute in bang gamtat khialhna nei uh ahhi hiam? Kong thuum hi Yahweh ka Pa aw, kei leh ka pa’ innkuan langah Na khut liik inla, ahih hangin Na mite tungah pulpi tungsak nawn kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David pai-in Yebus mi Ornan ancilna munah Yahweh aa dingin biaknatau khat a lamna dingin Gad in David kiangah a gen nadingin Yahweh’ vantungmi in thu a pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gad kammal tawh kizui-in David paito hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Gad in Yahweh’ Min tawh a genzo hi.
Tu-in Ornan kihei-in vantungmi a mu hi. Amah tawh a om a tapa lite kimu uh hi; ahih hangin Ornan in a mangbuh cilna a zom lai hi.
Tua ciangin David in ama lam manawh a, Ornan khuadakin David a hih lam a theih ciangin, ancilna panin amah paikhia a, lei lamah a maingatin David mai-ah a kun hi.
David in Ornan kiangah, “Yahweh tungah biaknatau khat ka lam nadingin na ancilna phual kei hong neisak in. Mite tunga pulpi a khawl theih nadingin a man cing takin kei tungah hong zuak in,” a ci hi.

Ornan in David kiangah, “La inla, ka uk kumpipa in hoih nasak bangin sem in. En in, meihal biakna-a dingin bawngtalte, a sing dingin ancilna vante, leh an tawh biakna dingin mangbuhte kong pia ding hi. Na khempeuh kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Kumpi David in Ornan kiangah, “Hi lo hi, a man cing takin kong lei ding hi. Yahweh aa dingin nang aa khatpeuh kong sang kei ding a, keima sum bei loin meihal biaknate zong ka pia kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Ornan tungah a mun lei nadingin kham shekel zaguk a gik pia hi.

David in tua lai-ah Yahweh aa dingin biaknatau khat lam a, tua ciangin meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate a pia hi. Amah in Yahweh sam a, Yahweh in vantung panin meihal biaknatau tungah meikuang tawh amah a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in vantungmi thupia a, tua ciangin amah in a namsau a paai ah a siat hi.
Tua hun lai-in Yahweh in Yebus mi Ornan ancilna phual ah amah a dawnna David in a muh ciangin, amah in tua lai-ah biakpiakna a pia hi.
Tu-in Mosheh in gamlaka a bawl biakbuk leh meihal biakna aa ding biaknatau pen tua hunin Gibeon-a mun sang ah a om hi;
Ahih hangin David in Yahweh kiang thu a dong dingin tua mai-ah pai lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Yahweh’ vantungmi’ namsau a kihta hi.
Tua ciangin David in, “Hih in Yahweh i Pa Inn aa dingin mun hi a, hih in Israyl-te aa dingin meihal biak nadingin biaknatau omna ding mun ahi hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in tua gama a teng peemta khempeuh a kikaikhawm dingin thupia a, tua ciangin amah in Yahweh’ Inn lam nadingin suangte a at dingin suang-atte a suaksak hi.
Amah in kongpi kongkhaka zat ding siktukilh-te bawl nading leh a gak nadingin sik honpi khat leh a gikzah teh zawh loh sumngo tampitak a puak hi.
Amah in simzawh loh taamtak singluangte zong puak hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Sidon mite leh Tyre mite in David kiangah tuate tampitak a puak uh hi.

David in, “Ka tapa Solomon khangno lai a, a tuahkhak om nai loin, Yahweh aa dingin a kilam ding Inn pen gam khempeuh ah nakpi takin a thupi, a minthang, nopci mahmah hi hamtang ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua dingin ka kigingkhol ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in a sihma-in na tampitak a kigingkhol hi.
Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon samin, Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa aa dingin Inn khat a lam nadingin thu a pia hi.
David in Solomon kiangah, “Ka tapa aw, Yahweh ka Pa Min aa dingin Inn khat lam ding ka lungsim sungah om a,

ahih hangin Yahweh’ kammal kei kiangah hong tungin, ‘Nang in sisan tampi suahin gal tampi na do hi. Nangmah in Keima mai leitung ah sisan tam suah lua na hih manin Ka Min aa dingin Inn khat na lam kei ding hi.

Ahih hangin en in, nang sung panin tapa khat hong piang ding a, amah pen kilemna nei mi khat hi ding hi; tua ciangin keimah in a pang khempeuh-a om a galte khempeuh kiang panin tawlngakna ka pia ding hi. Ama min Solomon; lemna, daihna, hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh keimah in kilemna pia-in, ama uk hun sungin Israyl ka tawldamsak ding hi.
Amah in Ka Min aa dingin Inn khat lam ding a, amah pen Ka tapa hi ding a, Kei pen ama Pa ka hi ding hi. Keimah in Israyl tungah ama kumpigam tokhom ka kipsak tawntung ding hi,’ ci hi.
Tu-in ka tapa aw, Yahweh in nang hong ompih tahen. Na mavang henla, Yahweh in nang tunga hong gensa bang teekteekin Yahweh na Pa Inn lam in.
Yahweh in Israyl tungah thupiapa in hong bawl ciangin Yahweh’ na Pa Thukham na zuih theih nadingin Amah in pilna leh thutheih telna hong pia tahen.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Israyl-te aa dingin Mosheh a thupiak ahi ngeina kipte leh thukhennate limtakin na zuih leh na mavang ding hi. Thahat inla, hang mahmah in. Lau kei inla lungkia kei in.

En in, haksatna tampi thuakin Yahweh’ Inn aa dingin kham talent 100,000, ngun talent 1,000,000, leh tam lua mahmah ahih manin a gikna tehzawh loh sumngo leh sik ka kigingkhol hi. Taamtak sing leh suang zong ka kholkhin a, ahih hangin tuate na behlap lai kul thei ding hi.
Na sem mi tampi na nei hi: suang-atte, suang nasemte, khutsiamte, leh nasep nam khempeuh-a khutsiamna namkim a neite—
kham, ngun, sumngo leh sik-te ah khutsiamte simzawh loh ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin nasep kipan inla, Yahweh in hong ompih tahen!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon a huh dingin Israyl makaite khempeuh thupia-in a gen inah:

“Yahweh na Pa un note hong ompih lo ahi hiam? Amah in na kiim na pam khempeuh ah gal daihna hong pia hilo ahi hiam? Amah in keima khut sungah gam sunga a tengte hong piakhin a, Yahweh mai leh a mite mai-ah gam sung khempeuh kinuaisiah hi.

Tua ahih ciangin na lungsimte uh kipsak unla, Yahweh’ na Pa uh zon ding kipan un. Dingto unla, Yahweh’ Min aa dingin a kilam ding Inn sungah Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang leh Yahweh’ nazat siangthote a kitumpih theih nadingin Yahweh i Pa’ munsiangtho lam un,” a ci hi.
David teekin a kum a cin ciangin, amah in Israyl tungah kumpi-in a tapa Solomon a bawl hi.
Amah in Israyl makaite khempeuh, siampite leh Levi mite zong kaikhawm hi.
Levi mite kum sawmthum leh a tungsiah kisim a, pasal mi phazah pen 38,000 ahi hi.
Hih mite lak panin 24,000-te in Yahweh’ Inn nasep uk ding uh a; 6,000 pen uliante leh thukhente hi-in;
4,000-te in kongcing ding uh a; tua ciangin David in phatna a pia dingin a seh mi 4,000-te in tumgingte tawh Yahweh phat ding uh hi.
David in Levi’ tapate ahi Gershon, Kohath leh Merari-te tawh kituakin Levi mite a pawlpawlin a khen hi.
Gershon’ tapate pen Laadan leh Shimei ahi hi.
Laadan’ tapate pen: a masa Yehiel, tua khit ciangin Zetham leh Yahyl hi a—a vekpi-in thum ahi hi.
Shimei’ tapate pen Shelomith, Haziel leh Haran hi a—a vekpi-in thum ahi hi. Hihte pen Laadan’ innkuan lutangte ahi uh hi.
Shimei’ tapate pen Yachath, Zina, Yeush leh Beriah ahi hi. Hih mi lite pen Shimei’ tapate ahi hi.
Yachath pen a masa hi a, Zina pen a nihna ahi hi; ahih hangin Yeush leh Beriah in tapa tampi nei lo uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute pen hih a pawlpawlte sungah a pa’ innkuan tawh khatin kisim hi.
Kohath’ tapate pen Amram, Ishar, Hebron leh Uzziel hi a—a vekpi-in li ahi hi.

Amram’ tapate pen Aaron leh Mosheh ahi hi. Aaron pen kiseh tuam a, a siangthopen nate a ap ding, Yahweh mai-ah biakpiaknate a piak ding, Ama mai-ah biaknasep a sem ding leh Ama Min tawh a tawntungin thupha piaknate a genkhia dingin amah leh a suanlekhakte a tawntungin kiseh tuam hi.
Yahweh’ mipa Mosheh’ tapate pen Levi’ minam lakah kisim khawm hi.
Mosheh’ tapate pen Gershom leh Yliezer ahi hi.
Gershom’ tapate lak panin Shebuel pen a masa ahi hi.
Yliezer’ tapate lak panin Rechabyah pen a masa ahi hi. Tu-in Yliezer in tapa dang a nei kei hi; ahih hangin Rechabyah’ tapate tam mahmah uh hi.
Izhar’ tapate lak panin Shelomith pen a masa ahi hi.
Hebron’ tapate lak panin, a masa Yeriyah, a nihna Amaryah, a thumna Yachaziel leh a lina Yekameam ahi hi.
Uzziel’ tapate lak panin Micahyah a masa hi a, Yeshiyah a nihna ahi hi.
Merari’ tapate pen Mahli leh Mushi ahi hi. Mahli’ tapate pen Eleazar leh Kish hi a,
ahih hangin Eleazar si-in tapa a nei kei hi. Amah in tanu bek nei a, tua ahih ciangin a sanggampa’ tapate in amaute a tenpih uh hi.
Mushi’ tapate pen: Mahli, Eder leh Yeremoth hi a—a vekpi-in thum ahi hi.

Hihte pen amau bawng tawh kizui-in Levi’ suanlekhakte ahi uh a—Yahweh’ Inn nasepna ah na a sem, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah, amaute’ minte a kikhumna zui-in a kiciamteh lai-in amau bawng innkuan lutangte ahi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh David in, “Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in a mite tungah tawlngakna hong pia-in Yerusalem-a tenna ah hong latokhin ahih nungsangin,
Levi mite in biakbuk ahi a, a nasepna dingin nazatte khatpeuh zong a puak ding uh kisam nawn lo hi,” a cizo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David’ kammal nunungpente tawh kizui-in Levi mite kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a kisim hi.
Amaute vaipuak pen Yahweh’ Inn nasepna ah Aaron’ suante huh ding ahi hi: huang sung leh inndeite sungah, a siangtho nate khempeuh a siangsak ding leh Yahweh’ Inn nasepna ah a huh ding uh ahi hi.
Amaute in sabuai tunga kikoih ompihna anlum, an tawh biakna aa dingin annel, silngo sawhloh mohphengte, a ki-emte leh a kigawmte, leh a phazah tehna leh a phacia tehna khempeuh a uk ding uh hi.
Yahweh tungah lungdamna a ko ding leh a phat dingin zingsang simin amaute ding ding uh a, tua tawh kibangin nitakin zong hih ding uh hi;

tua banah Shabbat nite, Kha Thak nite leh a kisehsa Pawi nite-a Yahweh tungah a kipia meihal biakna peuhpeuh ah zong ding ding uh hi. Amaute in mi phazah a kisehsa bang leh amau hih dingin a kilahzia bangin Yahweh mai-ah a hunhunin biaknasep sem ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk, Mun Siangtho leh Yahweh’ Inn nasepna ah Aaron’ suanlekhak a sanggamte uh lamlahna bangin Levi mite in a vaipuakte uh sem ding uh hi.
Hihte pen Aaron’ suan a pawlpawlte ahi hi. Aaron’ tapate pen Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Nadab leh Abihu pen a pa uh mai-ah si-in ta nei lo uh hi; tua ahih ciangin Eleazar leh Ithamar in siampi-in na a sem uh hi.
Eleazar’ tapa Zadok leh Ithamar’ tapa Ahimelech huhna tawh David in a kiseh amau nasep kigualhzia seh dingin amaute a pawlpawlin a khen hi.

Tu-in Ithamar sunga makaite sangin Eleazar sungah makai tam kimuzaw a, tua ahih manin amaute in Eleazar suante sung panin innkuan lutang sawm le gukin khenin, Ithamar suante pen innkuan lutang giatin a khen hi.
Eleazar’ suante lak pan leh Ithamar’ suante lak panin Yahweh’ Inn-a ulian leh munsiangtho-a ulian a sem dingin a nih tuakin a kibangin deihsak tuam om loin aidotna tawh a khen uh hi.

Levi mi Nethaneel’ tapa lai-at Shemayah in kumpipa leh uliante om mahin tuate gelhkhia a, tuate in: siampi Zadok, siampi Abiathar’ tapa Ahimelech, leh siampite leh Levi-te innkuan lutangte—Eleazar kiang panin innkuan lutang khat leh Ithamar’ kiang panin khat ahi hi.
Ailot masapen Yahyarib tungah tu a, a nihna Yedayah tungah,
a thumna Harim tungah, a lina Seorim tungah,
a ngana Malchiyah tungah, a gukna Miyamin tungah,
a sagihna Hakkoz tungah, a giatna Abiyah tungah,
a kuana Yahshua tungah, a sawmna Shecanyah tungah,
a sawm le khatna Eliashib tungah, a sawm le nihna Yakim tungah,
a sawm le thumna Huppah tungah, a sawm le lina Yeshebeab tungah,
a sawm le ngana Bilgah tungah, a sawm le gukna Immer tungah,
a sawm le sagihna Hezir tungah, a sawm le giatna Aphses tungah,
a sawm le kuana Pethahyah tungah, a sawmnihna Yehezekel tungah,
a sawmnih le khatna Yachin tungah, a sawmnih le nihna Gamut tungah,
a sawmnih le thumna Delayah tungah, a sawmnih le lina Maazyah tungah a tu hi.
Hih pen Yahweh Israyl’ Pa in ama thupiak bangin a pa uh Aaron in a seh biakna ngeina tawh kizui-in Yahweh’ Inn sungah a lut uh ciangin a kisehsa amau nasep kigualhzia ahi hi.
Levi’ suan a omlaite: Amram’ tapate panin Shubael, Shubael’ tapate panin Yechdeyah ahi hi.
Rachabyah suan ama tapate sung panin a masa Isshiyah ahi hi.
Izhar mite sung panin: Shelomoth, Shelomoth’ tapate sung panin Yachath ahi hi.
Hebron’ tapate pen Yeriyah a masa, Amaryah a nihna, Yachaziel a thumna, leh Yekameam a lina ahi hi.
Uzziel’ tapate pen Micayah hi a, Micayah’ tapate lak panin Shamir ahi hi.
Micahyah’ sanggampa pen Isshiyah hi a, Isshiyah’ tapate sung panin Zecharyah ahi hi.
Merari’ tapate pen Mahli leh Mushi ahi hi; tua khit ciangin Yaaziyah’ tapate lak panin Beno ahi hi.
Merari’ suante Yaaziyah panin Beno, Shoham, Zaccur leh Ibri ahi hi.
Mahli’ tapa pen Eleazar hi a, amah in tapa nei lo hi;
Kish panin: Kish’ tapa Yerachmeel ahi hi.
Tua banah Mushi’ tapate pen Mahli, Eder leh Yerimoth ahi hi. Hihte zong amau bawng tawh kizui-in Levi mite ahi uh hi.

Amaute in zong a sanggamte uh Aaron’ suanlekhakte mah bangin Kumpi David, Zadok, Ahimelech leh siampi bawng lutangte leh Levi mite omin ai a lawn hi. A sanggam upente innkuante leh a sanggam naupente innkuante a kibangin a hih uh hi.

David leh amah tawh galkap makaite in harp khausaite, zither khausaite leh daltuahte tawh kopin lawp takin lasakna a sem dingin Asaph, Heman leh Yeduthun’ suante pawlkhat sehtuam uh hi. Amau nasep tawh kizui-in tumgingsiamte pen:
Asaph’ tapate lak panin: Zaccur, Yahseph, Nethanyah leh Asarelah ahi hi. Asaph lamlahna nuai-a Asaph’ suante in kumpipa makaihna nuai-ah lawp takin la a sa uh hi.

Yeduthun sung panin Yeduthun’ tapate pen: Gedalyah, Zeri, Yeshayah, Shimei, Hashabyah leh Mattithyah hi a—a vekpi-in guk hi-in a pa uh Yeduthun makaihna nuai-ah omte ahi uh hi. Yeduthun pen zither khausai zangin lungdam kohnate leh Yahweh tungah phatnate tawh kisai-in lawp takin la a sapa ahi hi.
Heman sung panin Heman’ tapate pen: Bukkyah, Mattanyah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Yerimoth, Hananyah, Hanani, Elyathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Yoshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, leh Machatzyoth ahi hi.

Hihte khempeuh pen kumpipa’ thumupa Heman’ tapate ahi uh hi. Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in amah a kitawisang nadingin ama tunga kipia a tapate hi a—Yahweh aa dingin Heman in a tapa sawm le li leh a tanu thumte a pia hi.

Hihte khempeuh pen Yahweh’ Inn-a nasem dingin Yahweh’ Inn ah daltuahte, harp khausaite leh zither khausaite tawh lasakna lamsang ah a pa uh makaihna nuai-a omte ahi uh hi. Asaph, Yeduthun leh Heman-te pen kumpipa’ lamlahna leh thuneihna nuai-ah om uh hi.
Amaute leh Yahweh lasaknate ah a hilh a siam amau sanggamte a phazah pen 288 ahi hi.
A neupen panin a lianpen dong; a sinte panin a siate dong, hih nasep a sem dingin amaute in ai a lawn uh hi.
Asaph tunga a tu ai masa pen Yahseph aa ding suak a, a tapate leh a sanggamte—la siam 12 ahi hi. A nihna-in Gedalyah aa dingin hong hi a, a tapate leh a sanggamte—lasiam 12 ahi hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh’ kumpi-tokhom tungah amah tu-in a pa David kumpi’ za a luah hi. Amah daupai-in Israyl khempeuh in ama thu mang hi.
Uliante khempeuh, mi thahatte khempeuh leh Kumpi David’ tapate khempeuh zong Kumpi Solomon tungah a ki-ap uh hi.
Tua hi a, Yahweh in Israyl khempeuh mit ah Solomon nakpi takin tawisang a, thupitna lian mahmah amah a piak bangin ama ma-a Israyl kumpite khat beek in a ngah ngei kei uh hi.
Yishai’ tapa David in Israyl khempeuh a uk hi.
Amah in Israyl a uk hun sung pen kum sawmli hi a—Hebron ah kum sagih ukin Yerusalem ah kum sawmthum le kum thum a uk hi.
Amah kum cingin si a, nuntak sau-in hau a, pahtawina a ngah hi; tua ciangin a tapa Solomon in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Kumpi David uk hun sunga thupiangte a pat panin a tawp dong thumupa Samuyl’ laibu, kamsang Nathan’ laibu leh thumupa Gad laibu sungah,
ama uk huna thupiangte, a vangliatnate, a nuntakna, a kumpigam leh gam sung kumpigamte khempeuh lakkhia-in a kigelh hi.
